jobs.title: Chief Product & Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

About ZAP Solutions

ZAP Solutions is the market leader in admissions and enrollment management software for medical, health professions, graduate, and undergraduate programs. Our flagship AMP platform, along with our CRM, SAMS, and Schedule Today modules, is trusted by more than 175 higher education programs across the US, Canada, and Australia to run applicant recruitment, review, interview scheduling, and matriculation. Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Pittsburgh, ZAP was acquired by Banyan Software and is entering a new phase focused on platform modernization, AI-enabled workflows, and expansion of its customer base.

The Opportunity

ZAP is at an inflection point. The company has built a durable market position on the strength of deep client relationships and customization, but that model now needs to evolve into a modern, scalable SaaS platform capable of doubling the customer base without doubling the codebase. The engineering organization has operated without a formal leadership layer for years, and there is no formal product management function. The incoming CPTO will unify product direction and technology execution under a single accountable seat, bring structure and product management maturity to a team of experienced developers, and establish an AI-first operating rhythm.

You will join ZAP Solutions directly as a core member of the leadership team, reporting to the CEO. You will set product direction, own the technical foundation, shape culture, and drive transformation with your own hands on the work. The platform has to be reliable, the data has to be an asset, and the opportunity to create competitive distance through AI is real.

What You Will Own

Product Direction and Discipline

- Own product direction as the synthesis of customer signals, usage data, and market insights, moving the roadmap from customer-reactive to market-facing.

- Run product discovery personally: focus groups, customer advisory councils, spec creation, and validation, particularly during year one while a product function is being built.

- Establish formal prioritization, roadmap, and release planning practices, communicated internally and to customers.

- Partner closely with the VP of Client Success, who holds the deep customer relationships today, to build a product operating model that plays to both strengths.

- Lend the product voice to enterprise sales cycles and Customer Success partnership.

Technology and Architecture

- Define and execute the technical vision for the AMP platform and companion products (CRM, SAMS, Schedule Today), ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and built for the next phase of growth.

- Drive consolidation of the multi-codebase legacy footprint toward a modern, maintainable SaaS architecture that preserves ZAP's reputation for client responsiveness while lifting the cost of customization.

- Design a data architecture that serves analytics, BI, and AI as a unified estate, positioning ZAP for AI capabilities generic models cannot replicate on applicant and enrollment data.

- Lead adoption of AI-assisted development practices across the engineering team, moving from ad hoc use of tools like Claude Code and Cursor to a systematic capability that improves throughput.

- Own security, compliance, and data privacy practices appropriate for a higher education SaaS environment, including FERPA, PCI-DSS, and WCAG/Section 508 accessibility standards.

- Manage technical debt pragmatically, balancing remediation with forward momentum on the roadmap.

Leadership and Culture

- Build and lead a high-performing engineering team of 10 to 15, identifying and developing internal team leads, and creating the first formal management layer this organization has had.

- Establish engineering and product-ops practices that scale without bureaucracy, moving the team from reactive work assignment to a proactive roadmap.

- Calibrate change to team tenure and mission-criticality. ZAP's developers have been in seat for years, and the transformation has to bring them along.

- Invest in reskilling the team for AI-native ways of working.

- Address underperformance directly and quickly, without waiting for HR.

Executive Partnership

- Serve as the CEO's primary product and technology partner on business direction, market positioning, and investment decisions.

- Identify where AI and platform capabilities can reshape market position and create durable competitive advantage.

- Represent the product and technology vision with conviction in executive, customer, and board conversations.

- Push back constructively on decisions that trade short-term velocity for long-term product or platform health.

What We Are Looking For

The Future Forward CPTO is a proven SaaS leader who unifies product vision and technology execution under a single accountable seat, and is comfortable leading through modernization and platform inflection. This is not a traditional CTO or CPO role. It demands someone who holds deep product thinking and technical delivery in equal measure, leads with an AI-first methodology, and is energized by transformation rather than threatened by it. They are close enough to the product and code to stay personally connected, and mature enough to modernize a legacy platform without disrupting the customers and long-tenured teams who depend on it. They choose this environment because it offers something bigger organizations cannot: the ability to set product direction, own the technical foundation, shape culture, and drive transformation with their own hands on the work.

Must-Haves

- Led a technology and product transformation in tandem, with specific delivery and adoption outcomes, and brought the team through the change rather than around it.

- Shipped AI-embedded product capabilities with measurable outcomes, or led sustained AI experimentation with clear conviction about where it creates durable value. Personal, daily agentic AI use, not talking about it at a distance.

- Owned product direction as the synthesis of customer signals, usage data, and market insights, and can point to a roadmap they moved from customer-reactive to market-facing.

- Owned a SaaS platform's security posture and compliance requirements (SOC 2, industry-specific standards) personally, not through a delegated security team.

- Designed or redesigned a data architecture that serves analytics, BI, and AI as a unified asset.

- Built and scaled an engineering team, including hiring, developing engineers into leaders, and managing performance directly. Addressed underperformance directly, not through HR.

- Made architecture and product investment decisions with direct commercial rationale tied to retention, revenue, or competitive moat, and can make an investment case a CFO would accept.

- Ran product discovery personally: customer conversations, spec creation, prioritization frameworks. Comfortable holding the product credibility of the company in enterprise sales cycles.

Bonus Points

- Experience in EdTech, higher education technology, admissions or enrollment management, CRM ecosystems, or comparable vertical SaaS with heavy customization patterns.

- Familiarity with centralized application services (AMCAS, CASPA, PharmCAS) or SIS/CRM integrations common in higher education.

- Background operating in an AWS-primary infrastructure environment with regulated data (FERPA or comparable).

- Track record consolidating a multi-codebase or heavily forked platform into a maintainable SaaS product without breaking client trust.

Why ZAP Solutions

Category dominance backed by hard numbers. 64 percent of US medical schools run their admissions on AMP. Over 6 million applications processed through the platform. 175+ higher education programs across the US, Canada, and Australia. 95 percent customer satisfaction. 99 percent AWS uptime. Starting position is compounding a proven business, not rescuing a broken one.

A full product portfolio to unify and extend. The CPTO owns product direction and technical foundation across ZAP's entire portfolio, not a single-feature product.

A permanent home, not a portfolio play. Banyan buys, holds, and grows software companies for life. We never resell. You can invest in architecture, teams, and platforms without a three-to-five-year exit clock cutting your work short.

A peer network. A community of Banyan portfolio company product and technology leaders navigating the same challenges: modernization, AI adoption, scaling teams, and building on acquired codebases.

The expected base salary for this position is: USD $200,000 to $250,000+ excluding annual bonus and equity (when applicable). Salary is based on a number of factors including market conditions, location and may vary depending on job-related skills and experience.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

Chief Product and Technology Officer (CPTO) · Classter

Location: Remote (Kavala, Greece HQ)

Compensation: €100,000 – €120,000 gross per annum, plus benefits. Offers are anchored within this published range based on the experience and scope the candidate brings.

About Banyan:

Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. We are on a mission to acquire, build, and grow great companies worldwide, helping them modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. Banyan is Great Place to Work Certified, a five-time Inc. 5000 honoree, and a top 10 company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Atlanta, Banyan operates more than 100 portfolio companies across North America, the UK, EU, and APAC.

About Classter:

Classter is an end-to-end, modular Student Information System (SIS) for education. It gives institutions a single system of record in place of multiple legacy tools, covering admissions, academics, the full student lifecycle, LMS, CRM, communication, billing and payments, with mobile apps on top. We serve private institutions, from K-12 and academies to higher education, across more than 40 countries. Our strongest base is in Greece and Cyprus and across Europe, with a growing footprint in North America and beyond. Classter is part of Banyan Software, a permanent-capital holder of vertical software businesses. Banyan backs its companies for the long term, with no exit clock and no pressure to optimize for a sale.

The Role:

Classter has a strong, feature-rich product and a solid engineering organization. The next phase is scale. It starts with a clear product vision and an ambitious roadmap, delivered through an AI-centric approach, a solid architecture, and a proactive motion that leverages Classter's proven, unique expertise. To match that ambition, we are creating a new seat. As CPTO you own Product and Engineering together. It is product-led, the center of gravity is product, and it is a real technology leadership seat, not a product role with engineering bolted on. You report directly to the CEO, work alongside your peers the COO and the head of Sales, and lead experienced Product and Engineering teams already in place.

What you will own

- Product vision, roadmap and prioritization, end to end. This is the core of the role, and more so as AI reshapes the product.

- Product direction and priority arbitration across the company, done in the open with the CEO and the leadership team.

- The engineering organization: its structure, delivery, quality and growth. You lead it through its team leads and own its direction and standards.

- Alignment of Product with go-to-market, the ideal customer profile and Sales, so the company builds with intent and stops shipping ad hoc.

- Technical strategy and architecture, keeping the platform coherent, scalable and secure, and able to support the roadmap.

- Predictable delivery, turning the roadmap into shipped software at a reliable pace.

- A deliberate approach to AI, in the product and in how the team builds, with a clear business model behind it.

Your first twelve months

- A product vision and roadmap the whole company understands and can execute against.

- A shift from a reactive, request-driven motion to a proactive, roadmap-driven one.

- Product, ICP and go-to-market visibly aligned (in collaboration with the other C's), with ad hoc development materially reduced.

- A credible plan to scale the product architecture, sequenced and underway.

- Engineering delivering to the roadmap at a predictable pace, with clear standards in place.

- At least one meaningful AI move, in the product or in how the team builds, with a business model attached.

The team you will lead

You report to the CEO and sit on the leadership team. You lead six teams, each with an existing lead: Product Design & Analysis, Main Product Development, Mobile App and AI Features Development, Architecture and Integrations, Quality Assurance, and Technical Operations. You inherit a capable engineering organization with established leads, and strong product domain expertise. Your focus is direction and leadership.

What we are looking for

Essential

- A senior leader who has owned both Product and Engineering, or a product leader who has genuinely run engineering. Strong track record in B2B SaaS, ideally vertical software.

- You have owned product vision, roadmap and prioritization at scale. You decide, you do not only facilitate.

- You have led engineering organizations: architecture and technical strategy, delivery and quality, structuring and growing a team. Credible with engineers, not a manager who delegates the technology.

- Experience taking a complex, feature-rich product and making its architecture coherent and scalable.

- A clear point of view on AI, in the product and in engineering, with a business model behind it.

- You align product tightly with go-to-market and the ideal customer profile.

- You bring direction to a founder-led company and an established team without steamrolling them.

Nice to have

- Education, EdTech, or another regulated, workflow-heavy vertical.

- International, multi-market SaaS.

- Experience in a founder-led company moving from craft to scale.

- Exposure to M&A and product integration.

Why this role

- A real ownership seat across product and engineering, with the mandate to shape where Classter goes.

- A strong product and team to build on, not a turnaround from zero.

- A permanent-capital owner behind you, with a long-term horizon.

jobs.title: Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) - Aequitas Solutions
jobs.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

Chief Product and Technology Officer (CPTO)

Location: Remote, United States (Pacific Time Zone preferred; Southern California a plus)

About Aequitas Solutions

Aequitas Solutions is a mission-critical Student Information System (SIS) provider serving K–12 public school districts, with its primary markets in California and Michigan. Its platform, Q, supports the core administrative operations districts rely on every day: enrollment, attendance, compliance reporting, and data governance.

Aequitas competes on trust, customer responsiveness, and deployment flexibility. Unlike larger SIS vendors pushing districts toward centralized cloud hosting, Aequitas intentionally supports cloud, hybrid, and on-premise environments, giving districts genuine control over their data and infrastructure. That flexibility is a deliberate competitive differentiator in a market where data locality and procurement caution are facts of life. Aequitas was acquired by Banyan Software in 2022 and is actively expanding its product capabilities and customer footprint.

The Opportunity

Aequitas has a loyal, established customer base, a platform with strong underlying functionality, and a clear mandate to grow. The Chief Product and Technology Officer is the executive hire that activates that mandate: the person who takes full ownership of the product vision, technical strategy, and engineering execution, and drives the platform forward.

This is a role for a builder. With respect for the team and customer commitments already in place, the CPTO will establish AI-first development as the operating standard, define the modernization roadmap for a platform with a significant legacy technology footprint, and build the team structure and discipline needed to deliver on a multi-year product vision. There is real work to do, with real scope for impact.

The CEO operates as a genuine partner, not a day-to-day manager. The expectation is that the CPTO owns the function completely: how resources are deployed, how the team is structured, and how the product roadmap is executed. The CEO will communicate direction and flag when something is off course, but the decisions are yours. This is an environment that rewards entrepreneurial ownership and initiative. It is a good fit for someone who thrives with autonomy and wants to build something, not manage an established machine.

The CPTO reports directly to the CEO and sits on the Aequitas leadership team alongside the Director of Customer Success, Director of Finance, and heads of Sales and Marketing.

Why Aequitas

- You own the function. Full charter.

- Product vision, technical strategy, engineering execution, AI roadmap, deployment architecture. This role has genuine authority across all of it.

- The CEO relationship is collaborative. Autonomy with a real partner at the top.

- The CEO wants a peer at the table, not a line report waiting for direction. You will have the space to lead the function your way, with a leadership team that engages on outcomes, not process.

- Genuine competitive differentiation. A market position worth defending and extending.

- Aequitas’s multi-deployment model gives districts options that larger SIS vendors do not. The company is actively investing in its on-premise and hybrid capabilities as a growth lever, and the CPTO plays a central role in that strategy.

- Good bones, ready for what’s next. A platform with real depth.

- The Q platform has been built in close partnership with California and Michigan districts over many years. The customer base is engaged and loyal. The opportunity here is to modernize and extend a product that already works, not to rebuild from scratch.

- No exit pressure, no artificial runway. Banyan’s buy-and-hold model means stability.

- Aequitas is a permanent part of the Banyan portfolio. Investment decisions are made with a long-term lens, not shaped by a pending transaction.

- Public education is the mission. The work has real-world stakes.

- Aequitas serves public school districts. The platform underpins enrollment, attendance, and state compliance reporting for approximately one million students across California and Michigan. The impact is tangible.

What You Will Own

A culture built on trust and commitment

Aequitas is a close-knit organization with long-tenured employees, loyal customers, and a strong sense of responsibility to the districts it serves. The right leader will value that trust, build on it, and help the company evolve without losing what makes it strong.

Product and Platform Leadership

- Define and own the multi-year product and technology roadmap, shifting Aequitas from a customer-reactive posture to a market-facing one.

- Establish a formal product management discipline, including roadmap ownership, prioritization frameworks, and release planning.

- Balance product investment and innovation against platform stability, particularly during California’s CALPADS and Michigan’s MiDataHub compliance reporting cycles.

- Partner with the Director of Customer Success and district stakeholders to ensure roadmap decisions reflect real operational workflows.

- Support Sales and executive leadership with credible, accurate product positioning as Aequitas pursues growth beyond its existing customer base.

AI-First Product and Development Strategy

- Lead the implementation of AI-first development practices across the engineering team, in alignment with Banyan’s AI mandate.

- Define and execute an AI product strategy focused on practical, explainable capabilities that improve district staff productivity, data quality, and compliance confidence.

- Ensure AI design respects district expectations around data locality, deployment boundaries, and the regulatory constraints of K–12 environments.

- Partner with Banyan’s AI team and the internal AI Council to evaluate tooling, establish standards, and drive adoption across the development organization.

Engineering Leadership and Team Development

- Lead a team of approximately eight direct reports across development and database administration.

- Build team structure, shared processes, and cross-functional visibility where the engineering organization currently operates in silos.

- Establish development standards, quality expectations, and a release cadence that supports both cloud and on-premise customers.

- Evaluate team capability honestly and make the personnel decisions the business requires, with the judgment to do so in a culture that values long tenure and personal relationships.

Platform Architecture and Deployment Strategy

- Own platform architecture strategy across cloud, hybrid, and on-premise deployment models.

- Define and execute a modernization roadmap for a platform with a significant VB.NET legacy, without disrupting mission-critical operations or the customer experience.

- Ensure tenant isolation, security, and operational reliability across all deployment models.

- Develop the on-premise managed services opportunity as a strategic growth and retention lever.

Stakeholder and Cross-Functional Alignment

- Serve as the primary executive authority for product and technology decisions.

- Build a strong working partnership with the Director of Customer Success on roadmap priorities, product-CS alignment, and development resource allocation.

- Engage the Michigan consortium as a key co-development partner, navigating shared roadmap influence with care.

- Keep the CEO informed on key decisions, customer-facing risks, and anything with strategic or reputational implications before they become surprises.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

- Genuine AI-first development capability: an active practitioner who can lead a team through an AI development transformation.

- Strong technical foundation: infrastructure, architecture, and platform operations depth that earns the trust of a seasoned development team and holds up through a legacy modernization program.

- Hybrid, on-premise, or district-managed deployment experience: Aequitas’s multi-deployment model is a strategic asset, and prior experience in this environment accelerates impact.

- Real product instincts: the ability to think beyond the existing customer base, define a roadmap with commercial logic, and own the product function with genuine conviction.

- Team-building experience in small, complex environments: a track record of creating structure, accountability, and team cohesion where it did not previously exist.

- Change management maturity: the ability to move a long-tenured team toward new ways of working without damaging the culture or losing the people worth keeping.

- US work authorization.

- Ability to work in Pacific Time; based out of Southern California strongly preferred.

- Low-ego, high-accountability leadership approach: brings a steady hand, owns outcomes, and builds trust across teams through consistency and follow-through.

- Credibility across technical and business stakeholders: able to earn the respect of engineers, product leaders, and long-tenured employees while maintaining alignment with customer-facing priorities.

- Sound judgment in pacing change: understands how to introduce meaningful evolution within a mission-critical, relationship-driven environment without creating unnecessary disruption.

Strongly Preferred

- K–12 software or EdTech experience, particularly familiarity with how public-school districts procure, fund, and implement technology. This is a meaningful differentiator.

- Legacy modernization experience: a track record of managing migration off an existing tech stack without disrupting a mission-critical customer base. VB.NET familiarity is a genuine plus.

- Background at companies under 200 employees: the culture is small, close-knit, and founder-adjacent. Experience at a comparable scale is a strong indicator of fit.

Compensation

The expected base salary for this position is: USD $200,000-$250,000, excluding incentives (when applicable). Salary is based on a number of factors including market conditions, location, and may vary depending on job-related skills and experience.

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager-  Teamup
jobs.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

About Teamup

Teamup is a customizable shared calendar for business. 5 million people use a Teamup calendar every month to organize schedules, resources, and teams, from room bookings to complex job schedules for field crews.

About the role

Most people meet Teamup through a calendar someone shared with them. It solves their problem, and they come back. That sharing flywheel already drives Teamup's growth. This role builds on it: getting new admins to value faster, turning more viewers into admins, and making the move from free to paid clear and easy.

This is a full-stack growth product manager role, and Teamup's first dedicated to growth and reports to the CEO. You'll work amongst engineers and a dedicated support team, solving customer problems. As an independent self-starter, you find the problem, build the prototype, write the code with AI, open the pull request, ship it, and measure what it does.  This role is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the USA - Eastern time zone.

You'll own:

- Time to value: the first session for every new admin, from signup to a shared calendar that solves their problem.

- Activation: the definition, the events, the reporting, and the number.

- The referral loop: how a shared calendar turns viewers into admins, including viewers on their phones.

- The upgrade path: free plan limits, upgrade prompts, and the moment a free calendar becomes paid.

- The AI onboarding agent that guides new admins.

- The experiment cadence: what gets tested, what ships, and what gets cut.

What you'll do

- Talk with customers and read support conversations every week to find where people get stuck.

- Build prototypes to test ideas quickly.

- Write code with AI, open pull requests, and ship to production alongside the engineering team.

- Design with AI tools.

- Instrument the funnel and build the reporting you run the work from.

The numbers you'll move

Activation rate, time to value, viewer-to-admin conversion, and free-to-paid conversion.

You'll be a great fit if

- You have built and shipped products yourself

- You have 5+ years in growth or product at a self-serve software company where customers sign up and pay without talking to sales.

- You have owned onboarding, activation, an upgrade path, or an in-product share loop, with results you can name.

- You write production code with AI, open pull requests, write SQL, and instrument events yourself.

- You design with AI.

- You stay close to the customer and change the product based on what you hear.

- You are a self-starter who works independently alongside engineering and support.

- You have done this at a small company or as an early hire.

- You move fast.

jobs.title: Vice President of Product - BitCentral
jobs.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

Vice President – Product Management

Bitcentral  |  Banyan Software

Reports to: CEO  |  Location: Southern California preferred / Remote (US)

About Bitcentral

Bitcentral builds mission-critical media software that enables broadcasters and media organizations to produce, manage, and distribute the stories audiences depend on every day. For more than 20 years, our solutions have powered news, sports, and entertainment workflows for over a thousand media and entertainment organizations, combining the reliability customers describe as "it just works" with the innovation needed to move content faster across linear, digital, cloud, and emerging distribution channels.

Bitcentral is embedded in the daily workflows of many of the largest news organizations in the country. As a Banyan Software-owned company, Bitcentral offers established customer trust, long-term ownership stability, and meaningful product opportunity in a media landscape that is changing quickly. Banyan Software is a long-term owner of vertical software businesses whose model is to buy, hold, and grow companies permanently.

For a product leader, this is an opportunity to lead with real customer proximity, a proven foundation, and the ability to help define what comes next.

Vice President – Product Management

As Vice President of Product Management, you will own Bitcentral's product vision, strategy, and roadmap at a company-defining moment for broadcast and media technology. You will lead the evolution of Bitcentral from a trusted, established media software provider into a more modern, scalable, customer-led product company built for the next generation of broadcast and digital media workflows.

You bring a unique blend of product leadership, customer fluency, commercial judgment, and technical understanding. You will translate customer needs, market dynamics, and long-term competitive positioning into a prioritized product roadmap that balances innovation, platform stability, and the dependability standards broadcast customers require.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will serve as the executive owner of product direction, customer discovery, roadmap priorities, and long-term product strategy. You will partner closely with engineering, sales, finance, customer-facing teams, and strategic customers to define what comes next while protecting the reliability and trust that made Bitcentral successful.

This role requires product leaders who bring real-world experience in AI product development, pricing and business model transformation, and the judgment to navigate a platform migration from on-premise to hybrid cloud. Familiarity with broadcast media workflows and the dynamics of the broadcast industry is strongly valued.

This position may be based in Southern California near Bitcentral offices or remote within the United States, with travel as required for customer, company, and industry engagement.

Responsibilities

- Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring priorities reflect customer needs, market dynamics, and Bitcentral's long-term competitive position in broadcast and media software.

- Lead Bitcentral's transition from on-premise infrastructure toward hybrid cloud architectures while maintaining the reliability standards required for mission-critical broadcast workflows.

- Champion AI-first product development, identifying where media data, workflow intelligence, and automation capabilities can be transformed into new product lines and revenue streams, not just incremental feature improvements.

- Make deliberate build-versus-buy and sequencing decisions under resource constraints, balancing innovation investment with platform stability.

- Partner with sales leadership to translate customer signals, market trends, and strategic account needs into product priorities that protect retention and open expansion opportunities.

- Serve as a credible product voice with Bitcentral's largest broadcast clients, earning trust through domain fluency and a forward-looking product point of view.

- Lead pricing, packaging, and business model evolution as Bitcentral transitions from perpetual license models toward recurring revenue.

- Partner with finance and sales to sequence pricing and customer migration decisions in a way that protects relationships while building recurring revenue momentum.

- Measure product success against pro forma expectations and translate performance insights into roadmap, pricing, and investment decisions.

- Work closely with technology leadership to translate product strategy into execution priorities and maintain productive alignment between innovation speed and platform reliability.

- Build and lead the product function, shaping the team structure, decision rights, operating cadence, and culture required for a customer-led product organization.

- Communicate clearly and proactively with the CEO, Banyan Operating Partners, leadership team, and internal stakeholders on product performance, roadmap tradeoffs, strategic priorities, and market conditions.

Required Skills

- Senior product leadership experience in a B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or vertical software company, with direct accountability for product strategy, roadmap development and execution, customer adoption, and product-market fit.

- Demonstrated ability to make forward-looking product bets grounded in customer discovery, market data, usage signals, and long-term competitive positioning.

- Experience leading a product organization through a meaningful inflection point, such as platform repositioning, pricing model redesign, migration from on-premise to cloud, or market expansion.

- Practical AI product mindset, including experience shipping AI-embedded capabilities with measurable customer outcomes or leading sustained AI experimentation with clear conviction about where AI creates durable product value.

- Strong commercial judgment, including experience with pricing, packaging, customer migration, and business model evolution from perpetual license or services-heavy models toward recurring revenue.

- Credibility with enterprise or institutional customers, including the ability to serve as the primary product voice in strategic customer relationships.

- Ability to translate complex customer workflows, technical constraints, and market opportunities into a clear, prioritized product roadmap.

Highly Preferred

- Experience in broadcast media, television technology, content management, media asset management, playout, newsroom workflows, or a closely adjacent vertical.

- Familiarity with the workflows, reliability expectations, regulatory constraints, and buyer dynamics of large broadcast organizations.

- Experience modernizing established products without disrupting customers who depend on them for mission-critical operations.

- Experience with hybrid cloud, scalable software architectures, workflow automation, or AI-enabled enterprise applications.

- Ability to lead with both strategic altitude and operational discipline, including clear decision rights across product, engineering, sales, and customer-facing teams.

Why Bitcentral & Why This Role

- Significant impact and autonomy. Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap during a company-defining moment for the organization, with the opportunity to build on a strong customer-driven foundation to evolve the portfolio into a scalable, market-leading platform that serves the evolving needs of media organizations.

- Stability and long-term vision. As a Banyan Software-owned company, Bitcentral provides the benefit of long-term ownership stability through an owner whose business model is to buy, hold, and grow companies permanently.

- Strong foundation. Work with a company that already has a proven track record, with over 20 years of experience powering workflows for over a thousand media and entertainment organizations.

- Customer proximity. Direct influence on and proximity to large, mission-critical broadcast clients, serving as the executive owner of product direction and customer discovery.

- Opportunity to define the future. Help define what comes next for broadcast and media technology, balancing innovation with the reliability standards the company is known for.

- Strategic scope. Report directly to the CEO and take on high-level strategic challenges, from driving the evolution of business models toward recurring revenue to navigating technology shifts like hybrid cloud architectures and AI-first product development.

The expected base salary for this position is: USD $170,000-$220,000, excluding incentives (when applicable). Salary is based on a number of factors including market conditions, location, and may vary depending on job-related skills and experience.
